requirements.claim: SSGC:2024 clause 6.2 requires the structural sealant bite b_s to be not less than 6 mm and not less than b_s = W_k * a / (2 * sigma_des), where a is the shorter supported edge length of the pane and sigma_des is the manufacturer's declared design tensile stress; b_s is also capped at three times the sealant glue line thickness.
uncertainties: sigma_des is a manufacturer-declared value and is not in the supplied evidence.

requirements.claim: For projects in Region Q the National Annex clause NA.6.2 raises the minimum structural sealant bite from 6 mm to 8 mm; the bite formula in clause 6.2 is otherwise unchanged.
applicability_conditions: Applies because the project is stated to be in Region Q.

verification_procedure.action: Obtain the shorter supported edge length a of the pane and the manufacturer's declared design tensile stress sigma_des for the structural sealant.
Compute b_s = W_k * a / (2 * sigma_des) using the characteristic wind action W_k on the pane.
Take the design structural sealant bite as the greater of the formula value and 8 mm (the Region Q minimum), and confirm it does not exceed three times the glue line thickness.

missing_information: The characteristic wind action W_k on the pane and the sealant design tensile stress sigma_des are not in the supplied evidence.
